description: This file defines multiple repository classes in a Kotlin-based Android project, including RatingsRepository, ContentRepository, and APARepository. These classes interface with various services to fetch and submit data related to media ratings, content details, and settings.

classes.name: RatingsRepository
classes.description: Handles user ratings, likes, and aggregate computations for media groups.

classes.name: ContentRepository
classes.description: Fetches media item details such as poster and background URLs based on group ID.

classes.name: APARepository
classes.description: Retrieves media-related settings, legend keys, and icons from an APA service.

methods.name: getPriorLike
methods.description: Fetches the previous like status for a given group ID.

methods.name: submitLike
methods.description: Submits a like or dislike for a media group and updates aggregate ratings.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating and count for a group.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves media item details including title, poster, and background images.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Fetches rating settings from the APA service.

methods.name: getLegendKeys
methods.description: Retrieves legend key mappings from the APA service.

methods.name: getAssets
methods.description: Gets icon assets from the APA service.
